549-5256-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-5256-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s).
Repeat from step 3.
549-5256-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

2011-6758-7839.notablePrerequisites:
Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2011-6758-7839.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating 100 Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4399-4518-6967-7818.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Honest Rutstein.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-6967-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1409-3099-4460-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5231-5542-6144.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6144.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Goliath Paladin from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Goliath Paladin.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Goliath Paladin token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6144.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2532-4617-4906-7747.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2532-4617-4906-7747.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin abilities, adding eight {R} and giving creatures you control trample until end of turn.
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Jaxis' ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Jaxis abilities, creating a token that's a copy of each other creature you control with haste.
Put the token Agrus Kos into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Agrus Kos and Giant-Sized Flying Ant tokens trigger.
Resolve the Agrus Kos trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Giant-Sized Flying Ant trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat, using the Soulbright Flamekin token instead.

3151-4038-5963.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Elves.

2921-3652-4053-6989.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

4423-4872-6850-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
4423-4872-6850-6886.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

4186-5147-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
4186-5147-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1637-4377-4423-6850.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1637-4377-4423-6850.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and two other Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Aesi trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to draw Walk the Aeons from the top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

2146-2421-3705-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

attached to the Spider that has Thornbite Staff attached

1506-1729-2178.description:
Activate the Spider with Thornbite Staff and Burning Anger attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls and destroying it due to the Spider's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Shelob and the Spider tapped in step 1 trigger.
Resolve the Shelob trigger, creating a token copy of the creature that died that is a Food artifact.
Resolve the Spider trigger, untapping it.
Repeat as desired. You can also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1874-2919-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-2919-3197.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1143-1912-2366-2713-4552.description:
Activate Dryad Arbor by paying {0}, causing you to draw a card.
Dryad Arbor triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

856-3698-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar, Grinding Station and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

3750-6266.easyPrerequisites: Redshift, Rocketeer Chief does not have summoning sickness.
3750-6266.notablePrerequisites: Redshift, Rocketeer Chief has power 5 or greater.
3750-6266.description:
Activate Redshift by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

710-3055-5231.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Danitha.
710-3055-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Danitha, adding {R}.
When Danitha dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

1116-1818-3240-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-1818-3240-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

2167-4677-5626-5721.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-4677-5626-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

Cast the creature by paying {0}.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, and Cloudstone Curio triggers if the creature was not an artifact.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, if applicable, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the creature with mana cost {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

678-891-1430-2034-5214.notablePrerequisites: Next of Kin attached to Mirror Image.
678-891-1430-2034-5214.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mirror Image, adding {C}{C}.
When Mirror Image dies, Enduring Renewal and Next of Kin trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Mirror Image to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Next of Kin trigger, putting Mirror Image from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Boonweaver Giant.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Next of Kin from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Mirror Image.
Repeat.

2034-3764-4871.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

1124-2858-4074-4356.description:
Activate Chandra, Torch of Defiance's second ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Chandra, Hope's Beacon's first ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Ral Zarek's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, tapping any permanent and untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.

1604-4639.notablePrerequisites: Ith does not have summoning sickness.
1604-4639.description:
Declare Ith as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Ith by tapping it, targeting itself.
Ith triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Ith trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

596-1651-3340-4231.description:
Activate Darksteel Citadel by tapping it, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two artifact tokens, untapping Darksteel Citadel.
Repeat.

1722-1874-2034-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-1874-2034-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

225-539-765-2248.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Skyshroud Ranger as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

3002-3935.description:
Rest in Peace causes all cards in all graveyards to be exiled, and prevents any new cards from being put into a graveyard.
Opponents cannot pay for Web of Inertia's cost due to having no cards in their graveyard to exile.
